svg.title: Role-Based Prompting LinkedIn poster concept
svg.desc: A square LinkedIn post in brown, beige and cream tones titled Role-Based Prompting, subheading ABTalks 60-Day Claude AI Mastery Challenge, subtitle Turn Claude into Any Expert You Need, showing a comparison between a generic answer without a role prompt and an expert-level answer with a role prompt, plus five persona cards: Developer, Product Manager, HR Manager, Founder, Marketer.
svg.text: Turn Claude into Any Expert You Need
Claude can become any expert you need
One role assignment changes everything Claude gives back
